notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.content:
Update 1.4.1 has been released. List of changes that have appeared in the game:
* Changed interface in the game menu
* Purchases are now merged through the Steam overlay
* Updated prices in the store
* Fixed minor errors

This update was released thanks to your support and feedback!
Invite your friends and play together!

notes.title: Update 1.4.0.
Sports Festival!
notes.content:
Dear players, Paintball War 2 is participating in the sports festival!
Paintball is one of the most exciting, entertaining and interesting sports, where you need to apply both physical and tactical abilities, as well as which is loved by many people!
In honor of the festival, a 30% discount has been announced!
We prepared for the festival in advance and optimized the game a little so that you would be more comfortable playing Paintball War 2!
Now is the time to join the Paintball War 2 community and invite your friends, because it's more fun together!

notes.title: Update 1.3.2
Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
Dear players!
A major update 1.3.1 has been released, which introduces the ability to create your own rooms with unique game settings!
You can create a custom game in any game mode, choose the goal of the game according to the mode and the time of the round! And also, add bots and the ability to fire on your own!
Invite your friends and play unique matches together!

notes.title: Update 1.3
Update 1.2.4
notes.content:
Dear players!
Update 1.2.4 has been released with the following changes:
1. Added friends menu;
2. Added chat lobby.
Now you can add your friend to your friends list and send him private messages.
This is done for a reason! The ability to create groups to search for a game together with friends will be added very soon!
This update is made possible thanks to your support and your feedback on Steam and our Discord channel!

notes.title: Update 1.2.3
notes.content:
Dear players!
Update 1.2.3 has been released in which we have removed the long selection of the map and mode, now you can do it with one click! By choosing a mode, you start searching for a game that will take place on a random map, with random players!
This update is released thanks to your support and feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
Update 1.2.1
Update 1.2
Update 1.1.5
Update 1.1.4
notes.content:
Dear players!
Update 1.1.4 has been released with the following fixes:
1. The inscription "Game update" has been translated into all supported languages;
2. The Discord server icon is now only in the room search section;
3. The number of servers to choose from has been reduced to 6 to make it easier to find players and rooms.
This update came out thanks to the support of players who leave their feedback with suggestions, as well as those who write to us in Discord all suggestions and criticism about the game. We listen to everyone!
Invite your friends and play together!

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Dear players!
The game update 1.1.3 has been released which has been fixed:
1. Bots - now they do not pass through the chips on the maps Speedball, Speedball 2 and Speedball Max. And also they now run freely on the Castle map, and do not get stuck in the middle of the street;
2. Disappearing textures - When bouncing on Speedball cards, textures no longer disappear.
These are all the changes in this update.
Yes, I understand that this is too small a list, but at the moment, in addition to fixing bugs, I'm doing the classic Paintball game mode and getting sick, which is why all the work is less productive.
Thank you for your support, call your friends and play together!

notes.title: if (GameVersion != bl_DataBase.Instance.LocalUser.m_Avt249) {
notes.content:
Dear players!
Game update 1.1.2 has been released, in which we ensured that players who downloaded the game from pirated sources could not play Paintball War 2.
Now, we will be able to fully continue working on the classic modes that the game lacks so much.
The problem with an unexpected exit from the server, after which it was necessary to restart the game, was also solved.
Thank you very much for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Dear players!
Update 1.1.1 has been released in which minor game bugs have been fixed. Update list:
1. Fixed saving music settings.
Previously, after leaving a match, many had the problem of re-enabling menu music or returning to previous sound levels.
2. Fixed tackles in the match.
Now slides are triggered every time you want to use it, previously it was observed to trigger after a few clicks.
3. Fixed invisible buttons in the lobby.
There are no invisible buttons in the lobby with a password that prevented you from choosing a team and taking any actions.
4. Removed the icon of the position of the character in the match.
Removed the icon near the health level, which displayed the position of the character (standing or sitting).

Thank you for your support and feedback, I do my best to make the game better and you can enjoy it.

notes.title: Game Changes 1.1
notes.content:
Dear players!
On release, you gave a lot of feedback on Paintball War 2. We are currently working on some bug fixes. Now the Alley and Forest cards have been removed from the game, due to the fact that for most players these cards were very heavy on the computer.
Thank you for your support and your feedback, I can see and read everything!
Download the update and join the game!

notes.title: The game is already available!
notes.content:
Dear players!
The game is already available on Steam! Call your friends and play together!
We have already received feedback from you on the presence of some bugs, which we are already actively fixing and a patch will be released soon.
Also, many of you wrote that there is no classic paintball mode. It is already ready, but due to a number of errors in this mode, we had to remove it in order not to postpone the release of the game, in the near future it will be added to the game.
Good game!
You can write about found errors or your suggestions to our mail support@paintballwar.ru or Discord server https://discord.gg/NEhebGd

notes.title: Exact release time!
notes.content:
Dear players!
In order not to get confused about the start time, since everyone has different time zones, the exact start time is January 7 at 11:00 pm PST.
We are waiting for you and your friends!

notes.title: Game release!
notes.content:
Dear players!
Paintball War 2 has passed Steam Test!
Now we can finally call the release of the game! And it will take place on 01/08/2022!
Now we hope for your support, tell all your friends about the release of the game so that there will be as many players as possible on 01/08/2022!
We believe in our and your capabilities! We are waiting for everyone on the day of the start of the game!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Dear players! Happy New Year 2022!
We did not pass certain criteria by Steam. At the moment, because of this, the release date of the game is being postponed.
Unfortunately, we cannot give the exact date. The date will be known after successfully passing the Steam verification!
We will inform you as soon as the date is known.
We'll fix the bugs today and submit them for Steam review.
We also want to wish you good holidays!
Happy New Year!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Dear players, we wish you a Happy New Year! This year, we went through a lot in the development of the game and promised to tell you the release date of the game!
The game will be released on January 7, 2022, it remains to wait quite a bit! Thanks to you and your support, we were able to complete the development of the game and it remains only to test it on the Steam platform! Once approved by the platform, we can release the game and you can play what you've been waiting for!
Happy New Year! All the best to you in the New Year!

notes.title: Game release and advertising
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This month I will tell you the exact release date of the game, thank you for your support!
In the meantime, we are waiting, I have one small request for you.
Help promote, advertise the game.
Tell all your friends and acquaintances about the game, and I also know that there are a lot of you, let's put the hashtag # paintballwar2 together, wherever you can, and in unlimited quantities, thank you all for your help and understanding!

notes.title: Development is in full swing!
notes.content:
Dear players, the development of the game is in full swing!
Thanks for your support!
Call your friends, good games to you!

notes.title: Summer Steam Festival
notes.content:
Dear players!
Welcome to the Steam Games Festival from June 16 at 10:00 AM to June 22 until 10:00 AM Pacific.
At this festival you can play the demo version of Paintball War 2! Try out new mechanics, get acquainted with the new functionality of the menu, as well as see one of the many game maps in the game!
Call your friends and experience new sensations in the game together!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear players, Steam Next Fest is coming soon
Our team will take part in this festival with Paintball War 2!
At this festival you can play the demo version of Paintball War 2!
We would like to invite you to this festival so that you support us!
During the festival, you can also leave your comments and wishes for changing the game, indicate what you liked, and what else to work on!
We are waiting for you at Steam Next Fest!
